system.description:
You increase the size and volume of your hands before interlocking your fingers and slamming down with enough force to collapse the ground and surrounding terrain. Make a melee taijutsu (or ninjutsu) attack, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] + 2d12 force damage and forcing the affected creature to make a Strength saving throw, being knocked Prone on a failure.

If you have the Feral Axe or Feral Morningstar instinct, if you score a critical hit with this attack, the affected creature is also Staggered.

Amplify: By spending 2 Natural Energy as part of this jutsu’s casting, you activate chakra thrusters on your elbow, slamming your target into the ground, bouncing them like a ball, and then following it up with a heavy swipe, throwing them 30-feet in a direction of your choice, excluding upwards. A creature thrown this way makes their saving throw to resist being Prone at disadvantage

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost by 3 and the damage by 1d12.
